# Rockstar.Store

> Rockstar.Store is an online store for Roblox top-ups, game items, accounts, and services.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://rockstarstore.id/): Browse the store and current product catalog.
- [Robux top-up](https://rockstarstore.id/?tab=topup): View Robux top-up products.
- [Brainrot items](https://rockstarstore.id/?tab=brainrot): Browse Brainrot game items.
- [Roblox accounts](https://rockstarstore.id/?tab=akun): Browse Roblox account listings.
- [Joki services](https://rockstarstore.id/?tab=joki): View available game services.

## Site information
- [Sitemap](https://rockstarstore.id/sitemap.xml): Index of public store pages.
- [Robots instructions](https://rockstarstore.id/robots.txt): Public crawler access and sitemap information.
